description: Returns a checkout link for a one-time credit pack purchase on the connected Magic Hour account. Pass credit_shortfall from an insufficient_credits refusal to start with enough packs. Charges nothing; the user pays on the checkout page. Show checkout_url unchanged.

credit_shortfall.description: Credits the refused request is missing.

pack_count.description: Credit packs to start with, when the user names a number. Takes priority over credit_shortfall.
